name: Bauernhof Winklerhof
beschreibung: The Bauernhof Winklerhof in Ebbs is run as a welcoming country inn offering comfortable accommodation. Surrounded by open farmland and meadows, the property provides a peaceful alpine setting. The guest rooms are simple, neat, and functionally furnished. The kitchen takes pride in using homegrown produce directly from the farm, serving authentic Tyrolean dishes in the rustic dining parlor. The scenic surroundings are ideal for relaxing walks and invigorating hikes, exemplifying the harmonious blend of farming traditions and genuine Tyrolean hospitality.
